description.value:
Vibrant Display of a Thousand Cherry Blossoms. Two rows of a thousand blades rise from the ground and scatter.

You gain a second 20-foot emanation centred on a point within 60 feet. At the start of each of your turns, each enemy in either emanation takes @Damage[5d6[slashing]] damage with a basic Reflex save.

You can Sustain once per round to move the second emanation up to 30 feet, or to switch between these modes:

  • Gokei (Total Scene) — the blades amass into a sphere around one creature and implode. The second emanation shrinks to a 10-foot burst centred on one enemy; that enemy takes double the damage and cannot benefit from cover or concealment against it.
  • Senkei (Slaughterscape) — you abandon defence entirely. The blades condense into a thousand swords forming a 20-foot cage around you and one enemy. Neither of you can leave; your Strikes against that enemy ignore all resistances, and you may make one extra Strike each round at your current multiple attack penalty. You lose Senbonzakura's reach and cover-ignoring, and enemies outside the cage cannot be targeted by you.

Canon: Senkei "abandons the defensive attributes to focus entirely on offense."
